hypothesis: Current race-order gap magnitudes and their recent changes add predictive information beyond the original 80 features and a category/measurement-quality control.

inputs.reference: Reuse old 2022-fit base HGB for training-year inference and exact closed 2023 base forecasts; do not refit it.

features.support: Exactly frozen BOM-corrected pilot race_order_gap_ready, max10seconds at cutoff; no history-support requirement; all unsupported forecasts retain exact base HGB bits.

content_semantics.rank: Current valid integer Position 1..20; NaN otherwise. Position persists until an explicit update; no invented freshness expiration.
content_semantics.leader_gap_seconds: Fresh valid nonregressed numeric GapToLeader clipped[0,180]. Fresh leader/leader_lap_counter becomes0 only with rank1 and no leader_rank_category_inconsistent flag; other categories NaN.
content_semantics.interval_seconds: Fresh valid nonregressed numeric interval clipped[0,60]; categorical or stale interval is NaN, including a categorical leader marker.
content_semantics.leader_lap_deficit: Fresh valid nonregressed lap_deficit count clipped[0,20]; fresh seconds/consistent leader category implies0; invalid/stale NaN.
content_semantics.is_leader: 1 if valid rank1,0 if valid rank2..20,NaN if invalid rank.
content_semantics.interval_under_thresholds: For an available numeric interval only, strict <1,<2,<5 seconds; otherwise NaN.
content_semantics.history_content: Raw numeric seconds before final clipping, restricted to the frozen history policy.

quality_semantics.per_field: observed=field has source sequence; valid=rank for Position or seconds/leader/leader_lap_counter/lap_deficit for gaps; fresh=observed age<=10 and nonregressed irrespective of value validity; age_seconds=clip(age,0,180),180 if unobserved.
quality_semantics.category: seconds,leader(includes leader_lap_counter),lap_deficit,other are mutually exclusive, including unobserved/clear/invalid in other. These category states are retained in the stronger control; this tests added magnitude/dynamics information.
quality_semantics.flags: Seven pilot flags, followed by exact support bit, unchanged.
quality_semantics.history: Availability flags for delta5/delta15/trend; number of distinct retained observations clipped at128; retained time span clipped[0,30]. Diagnostic count clipping does not truncate the actual history used.

history.strict_window: cutoff-30s <= available_time < cutoff; same-availability explicit interval updates collapse to the latest physical sequence.
history.reset: Reset on actual observed Position(category,value) change, including rank clears/invalidity, or explicit interval update with any non-seconds category. Metadata-only interval updates do not refresh or reset. No history admitted for invalid rank or rank1. Apply entire packet before query.
history.record: Append only explicit finite nonnegative numeric interval updates with nonregressed source clock and valid follower rank. An explicit regressed numeric update resets history and is not appended. Store source sequence, availability and raw seconds.
history.query: Content needs a current fresh valid nonregressed numeric follower interval and exact equality of source sequence, availability and raw value to the newest retained history observation. Otherwise all four history content coordinates are NaN and availability flags false.
history.deltas: Newest observation minus the most recent retained observation at least5/15 seconds older than newest, clipped[-30,30]. Require such an older observation; do not interpolate.
history.trend: OLS of interval_seconds on availability seconds, using all retained distinct-time observations; at least3 with span>=15s; slope clipped[-2,2] seconds/second. Stable scaled arithmetic for large finite values.
history.range: max-min interval seconds over at least1 retained observation, clipped[0,60]; requires same query validity as other history content.

models.weights: N/(E*n_event) over all original matched2022rows, including unsupported gap rows.
models.control: Identical125column layout; all12content coordinates replaced by0 including NaNs;33quality coordinates retained verbatim.

selection_gate.failed_screen: Stop fixed family; no later TimingData acquisition or transfer, no parameter/feature/coverage retuning.

uncertainty.weighting: equal event weight; driver contributions sum to event-balanced delta

later_gate.fit: If screen passes, refit gap and quality on all38370matched2022-2023rows; reuse current portable80feature HGB. Keep exact gap feature/sampling/latency settings.
later_gate.other_requirements: Each historical year improves; negative event/block3 interval upper bounds and allLOO means in each block; positive0slag gain against both references. Never label exposed later seasons pristine.

execution.freeze: Hash all consumed source dependencies, old source/data/model/reference closures, rawTimingData bodies, originalissuance and label bindings; synthetic tests before first44race feature build.
execution.prepare: Original target-free issuance metadata only; all44×2feature ledgers close before fitting. Save exact support/clocks/45values and provenance; JSON strict null for missing floats.
execution.select: Two2022fits only. Save models and all3forecasts for every2023issuance at bothlags before attaching2023labels. External labels were previously exposed; closure protects execution order only.
execution.failure: Exclusive output and preserved failure receipts. Never overwrite failed attempts, narrow population or rescue by relaxed parameters.

limits: Race-order intervals do not certify the nearest physical car or an ahead-driver identity.
Lap deficit/invalid categories remain frozen; no new raw-string interpretation after pilot inspection.
Archive clocks and canonical issuance clocks are availability proxies, not certified historical client receipts.
Bothtrainingandselectionseasons are already exposed by earlier research.
Gap forecasts require a presence-sensitive timestamped live adapter before any global promotion; configured OpenF1 interval subscription alone is insufficient.
